label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Walk ends: a walk start or end that is a point on DOC's line (a hut, bivouac, shelter, lodge or campsite within 300 m) is taken as it is; DOC's leg distances only choose between line ends for places known roughly (a locality, a pass) or not placed. The Liverpool Track ended at the foot of the climb (DOC gives 'Pearl Flat to Liverpool Hut' as 1 km; the climb is 1.5 km and a separate piece of DOC's line) and now reaches Liverpool Hut (14.6 km).
A start or end chosen by distance is never the walk's other end (unless the walk is a loop between same-named places).
Found with this: the Wharfedale/Townshend Track ends at Wharfedale Hut, as DOC describes it, not 1.4 km past it.
dataChecks: Extent survey (232 DOC walks, extent-survey.txt): no walk where a line nearer DOC's stated distance was available and not chosen; compared with 0.1.49, four walks changed slightly (Greenstone and Caples 60.3 -> 58.4 km of DOC's 58.3 km loop line, Te Pua-a-Tāne 75.5 -> 74.8, two more walks now follow DOC's legs), none worse; 57 of 101 large walks with legs follow them, 108 of 117 leg spans within 25% of DOC's distances. Label survey (label-survey.txt): Liverpool Track 14.6 km by DOC's legs to the hut; Gillespie Pass, Greenstone and Caples unchanged.
